item.title: Why Rigid Notion Templates Break (And How Modular Blocks Fix Your Workflow)
item.description: Most Notion templates force you into a one-size-fits-all system that falls apart within a week. Here is how to build a flexible workspace using independent blocks.

item.title: Stop Rebuilding Your Notion Workspace: Why Modular Blocks Beat All-in-One Templates
item.description: Rigid Notion templates look great on Twitter but fail in real life. Here is how building with independent, mix-and-match blocks keeps your workspace adaptable as your projects change.
